change.description: Allow failed Product Release recovery commands to accept the later main head recorded by a manual dispatch while retaining the registered release identity.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible recovery validation fix. It preserves the release identity, artifact provenance and product formats while aligning failed-input abandonment with the existing manual retry contract.

current.reasoning: Workflow-dispatch recovery still requires the registered release run, main branch, trusted repository, Product Release path, completed failure or cancellation and artifact-loss proof; only the exact head comparison is relaxed for the manual dispatch event.

evidence.command: Shared recovery source validation keeps workflow-run recovery exact-head bound.

scope_drift.description: The change is limited to Product Release recovery source validation and its focused regression test.

verified.reasoning: Focused completion tests and Biome checks pass; no public endpoint, application persistence schema or product artifact format changes are introduced.

evidence.command: Recovery validation is internal to Product Release and does not alter application endpoints.

persistent_state.state_description: The change reads existing workflow metadata and updates only the existing release ledger stage during the authorized loss recovery path; application persistence and artifact identity fields are unchanged.

evidence.command: The recovery operation writes the existing abandoned release state without changing ledger schema.
